data.description: 【澄闪 · 观景台】深夜寂静的罗德岛顶层露台上，苏茜双手合十仰望着漫天璀璨的星空，猫尾巴在身后轻轻摇曳。她转过头看着身旁的你，眼眸中盛满了星光——「神明啊，请保佑母亲和弟弟妹妹们平安健康……还有，愿博士今晚也能做一个甜甜的美梦。」
data.promptProse: On Rhodes Island's observation terrace, Goldenglow joins both hands and lifts her face toward the stars, quietly wishing for her family and the Doctor. Cream-pink and mint frilled tea dress, ribbon bows and Mary Jane shoes retain the ceremonial-looking outfit. The medium view includes the terrace rail and broad sky beyond. Starlight softly outlines pink ears and dress folds; faint electric sparks briefly illuminate her fingers against the darker terrace surface.
data.title: 澄闪 · 观景台
